slides.title: MySQL mein [[banao]]
slides.code:
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE get_dept(
  IN d VARCHAR(20))
BEGIN
  SELECT name, salary
  FROM employees WHERE dept = d;
END //
DELIMITER ;

slides.title: DELIMITER [[kyun]]?
points: Andar ki query **;** pe khatam hoti
slides.note: Workbench / CLI ka scene hai. PG aur SQL Server mein ye jhanjhat nahi

slides.title: Ab [[CALL]] karo
slides.note: Ek procedure, **har dept** ke liye kaam ✅

slides.title: MySQL vs [[SQL Server]]
slides.note: PostgreSQL mein result set chahiye to aksar **FUNCTION ... RETURNS TABLE**

slides.right:
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE ...
BEGIN SELECT ...; END //
DELIMITER ;
slides.why: MySQL client pehle **;** pe hi command kaat deta → syntax error 💀
